name: Dionysius of Andros
bio: Dionysius of Andros is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no date for the poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 533).

poems.title: Book VII, 533
poems.author: Dionysius of Andros
poems.text: It is no great marvel that I slipped when soaked by Zeus and Bacchus. It was two to one, and gods against.a mortal.
